definitions.explanation: A container filled with hot water, used to warm the body, especially in bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{湯|ゆ}たんぽ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: In winter, I put a hot water bottle in the futon when I sleep.
I filled the hot water bottle with hot water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{湯|ゆ}たんぽ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温|あたた}められる→温める：02096_atatameru⟧。
examples.english: Modern hot water bottles can be heated in the microwave.

notes:
A {湯|ゆ}たんぽ is a hot water bottle, put into the bedding an hour before turning in so the futon is warm on a cold night. It remains a normal winter object in Japanese homes rather than an old-fashioned one.

Formation: ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ 'hot water' + たんぽ, from the Chinese-derived {湯婆|たんぽ} 'warming vessel'. Also written {湯湯婆|ゆたんぽ} or {湯婆|ゆたんぽ}, though the mixed form above is what people actually write.

Types, by material and heating method:
- ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦{製|せい}→製：noentry⟧: metal, the traditional kind, which can go straight on a stove
- ⟦{樹脂|じゅし}→樹脂：17424_jushi⟧⟦{製|せい}→製：noentry⟧ / ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦{製|せい}→製：noentry⟧: plastic and rubber, the everyday kinds
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{湯|ゆ}たんぽ: an electrically heated version
- ⟦レンジ→レンジ：01047_renji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: gel-filled, microwaved rather than filled

Collocations:
- {湯|ゆ}たんぽ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put a hot water bottle in the bed
- {湯|ゆ}たんぽ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}める→温める：02096_atatameru⟧: to warm one's feet with it

Prolonged contact with the skin causes ⟦{低温|ていおん}→低温：29339_teion⟧⟦やけど→火傷：04077_yakedo⟧, a low-temperature burn, so a {湯|ゆ}たんぽ is always used inside a cover.
